# Tyga Admits to Using AI on New '$tarface' Album (Billboard)

By Angel Diaz. Published August 6, 2026 (updated Aug 7).

## Key findings
- **Tyga** (West Coast rapper) admitted to using an **AI music generator** on his '80s-inspired synth-pop album **$tarface** (released July 31, 2026, as the "$TARFACE" / Tyga alter ego).
- He told VIBE he used AI for "'80s synths" and a "guitar solo": "we definitely used AI as a [tool]... it's no different than when Auto-Tune came out."
- He clarified: "as far as the writing, all the vocals are all me."
- The AI speculation was triggered by Shoreline Mafia's **Fenix Flexin** and his '80s-inspired single "RUBBERZ," plus footage of Tyga and Fenix in the studio on "Lavish."
- **Important correction (Billboard, Aug 7):** the story was updated to correct an error that stated Tyga used **Suno** specifically. He did **not** say he used Suno specifically — only that he used "AI as a tool."

## Assessment
- `authoritative: yes` — Billboard is a top-tier / domain authority.
- Establishes: Tyga (human rapper) admitted AI-assisted production on $tarface (AI used for '80s synths + a guitar solo); all writing/vocals are his own. Caveat: he did NOT specify Suno (Billboard corrected that claim); the AI tool was not named.
